scope: Diagnostic figure from independent saved numerical paths; not a manuscript panel reproduction

reference.certificate_basis: Exact rational coefficients from binary64 inputs; outward interval arithmetic and exact rational special cases
reference.time_ordering: Ordinary floating-point action evaluation; branch count is certified, but no interval bound on minimum-time ordering is claimed

selected_cases.ray_extraction_message: Exact endpoints connected by a descending FMM seed
selected_cases.observation_basis: catalog P pick minus reference origin
selected_cases.source_origin_resource_id_basis: provider reference origin; t is a correction in seconds
selected_cases.receiver_identifier_basis: derived from provider SEED codes using FDSN Source Identifiers v1.0
selected_cases.receiver_vertical_datum_basis: NCEDC documents station elevations and catalog geoid depth on the same datum; StationXML supplies no explicit vertical-datum field
selected_cases.receiver_elevation_semantics: Channel/Elevation interpreted as sensor elevation per StationXML; no separate burial correction
selected_cases.receiver_metadata_epoch_basis: Intersection of provider StationXML network, station and channel epochs
